description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取A股公司的配股记录。可按股票代码、时间范围进行筛选，返回配股日期、除权日期、配股货币、配股比例、配股价格、配股数量等数据。当用户想了解某A股的历史配股情况、追踪配股融资事件时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain rights issue (allotment) records for A-share companies. Filters can be applied by stock code and date range, returning fields such as date, ex-rights date, allotment currency, allotment ratio, allotment price, and allotment quantity. Call this interface when users want to understand the historical rights issue situation of an A-share or track rights issue financing events.

descriptions: 我的Token页有用户专属且唯一的Token。

params.name: stockCode
constraints: 请参考股票信息API获取合法的stockCode。

params.name: startDate
descriptions: 用于获取一定时间范围内的数据。
constraints: 开始和结束的时间间隔不超过10年

params.name: endDate
descriptions: 结束信息日期。用于获取时间范围内的数据，默认值为今天结束。
